text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein calls on armed forces to be vigilant and protect nation, says army "fights with honour and makes peace with honour".
- New Prime Minister Majali stresses priority of domestic concerns while standing by Palestinians in struggle to attain national rights.
- Crown Prince Hassan sends greetings to Jordanians on his 50th birthday, says he will put himself at service of people.
- King says incident in which Jordanian soldier gunned down seven Israeli schoolgirls "was a mark of shame that has touched all of us".
- Jordan, Algeria end talks on improving transport ties.
